limitations: Actual pixel review is coarse visual observation, not a pixel-for-pixel renderer replay or proof of all-state equality.
Public SVG route calculations independently match endpoint coordinates to public SVG port circles and check open card interiors. They prove source geometry only, not every raster endpoint.
Container interiors are intentionally excluded from leaf-card crossing checks; edges through container space can be expected.
Source-generated modal background occludes graph; only modal title, source presence, visible operators/actions jointly inspected.
DOM byte equality and identical image bytes do not establish capture synchronization or acquisition method.
No runtime, persistence, tiny typography, physical readability, performance or human acceptance certification.
